entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these garbage cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable. What's your name again? Isaac? I want this fixed now.
I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, could I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's sarah.vip@email.com. And don't give me the runaround. These things are useless.
Okay, I have your account pulled up, Sarah. Thank you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Are you kidding me? A preference? They gave me horrible blisters after one ride! I think there's something wrong with the way the cleats are supposed to mount, too. I've been a VIP member for three years, and this is the worst product I've ever gotten from you. I want a refund, and I want it now, or I'm taking this to social media.

I completely understand your frustration. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders, and I sincerely apologize. It sounds like a fit issue, which can certainly be frustrating to deal with.

It's more than frustrating! I'm supposed to be training. Just process the return. I don't have time for this. If I don't see a refund confirmation in my email in the next five minutes, I'm calling back to speak to your manager.

There's no need for that, I can resolve this for you right now. I see you received the cycling shoes just nine days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window. I am absolutely able to process a full refund for you. I've just initiated that and sent a prepaid return label to your email.
Fine. About time. This has still been a complete waste of my morning. You can be sure I'll be leaving a review about this.

I understand, and again, I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. As a valued VIP member, your experience is very important to us. To thank you for your patience and loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account. You can use that on any future purchase with us.
Oh. A $25 credit? Well... fine. That's something, I guess. Make sure it's actually on there.

It's already active on your account, Sarah. Once we receive the shoes at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. The instructions are all in the email. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Just make sure it gets done.
It will be. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
